messages: Alex: dropped a new mock for the heatmap + p95 overlay in figma. key change: mini-histogram under the sparkline and a tighter time-range picker. thoughts on the sampling control label? Marta: can we avoid generic 'Sampling'? it doesn't tell users the unit. 'Sample rate' is clearer. Jun: agree on 'Sample rate'. also propose we show the actual percentage next to the control (e.g., '10%') not just a slider position. less guesswork. Ravi: perf note: toggling sample rate from 1% to 100% triggers a big backend query. can we debounce or show a prompt for large ranges? Sam: debounce for live changes + an 'Apply' button for >50% ? alternative: immediate apply but cap visual updates until server ack. Alex: prefer debounce 250-400ms and a tiny inline spinner in the control. immediate feel but avoids rapid re-fires. Aria (a11y): a11y checklist: 1) control must be reachable by keyboard (tab), 2) state must be announced (e.g., 'Sample rate 10 percent'), 3) spinner announced as 'Updating heatmap'. use role=\"status\". Jun: here's a tiny aria example we can paste in the prototype: ``` Sample rate 10% ``` That way screen readers get immediate feedback. Marta: question about naming: we also have an 'Auto' option that adapts based on traffic. should label be 'Adaptive' or keep 'Auto'? Ravi: 'Adaptive' communicates intent; 'Auto' is ambiguous in docs and support. Sam: UX tradeoff: 'Adaptive' is longer and might wrap in the compact toolbar. Maybe show 'Adaptive' but truncate with tooltip on hover. Alex: agreed. tooltip copy suggestion: 'Adaptive: dynamically adjusts sample rate based on traffic volume and p95 variance.' I'll add to Figma. Aria (a11y): tooltip must be focusable and accessible. give it tabindex=0 and aria-describedby linking back. Jun: another micro-ux: when zooming the time-range picker, the scrubber currently snaps to bucket centers which causes confusion when buckets are sparse. propose elastic snapping: snap-to-bucket unless user zoom > 8m then snap to event timestamps. Marta: yep, we had a similar ask in QA. Documented behavior should be kept in the handoff doc. Ravi: backend: will add an endpoint param to request exact event times when zoomed, so client can render precise scrubber positions. Sam: copy nits for the p95 legend: change 'p95' hover text to '95th percentile latency (ms) — shows the latency experienced by the slowest 5% of requests'. users kept asking what p95 is. Alex: good idea. also add short inline unit toggle (ms vs s) in settings. Marta: acceptance criteria for this iteration: 1) label changed to 'Sample rate' + visible percent value; 2) 'Adaptive' option with tooltip copy added; 3) debounce 300ms with role/status spinner and aria-live update; 4) elastic scrubber snapping documented + backend flag for exact times; 5) p95 legend microcopy updated. Ravi: I'll queue the backend flag and perf test ticket. Jun: I'll push the aria snippets into the prototype and leave comments in figma. Aria (a11y): thanks — I'll run a quick screen-reader pass during the review. design-bot: Reminder: design sync in 30m on #design. Figma -> https://figma.com/file/abc123/heatmap-p95-handoff Marta: thanks team — see you in the review. :thumbsup:
